title: Let's Fly
description: A Paper plugin that allows normal players to fly in a region.
body:
The plugin is a specialized Minecraft server plugin built for the **Paper API**.  
It is designed to empower players—specifically those focused on technical Redstone or large-scale building—by providing localized flight capabilities within a restricted spatial boundary.  
Unlike global creative mode, manages flight state on a per-player basis, enforcing a configurable radius limit from the point of activation to maintain survival gameplay balance.  
Using:  
``/letsfly on``  

``/letsfly off``  

``/letsfly changeDistance {number}``(OP needed)  

``/letsfly reload``(OP needed)  
Other infomation:  
Support Bukkit permission system.  
Distance limit is configurable.
